Harbor is the Lighthouse customer web app. Build storefront pages, checkout, and account flows on one codebase, and deploy every change straight from the workspace you built it in.

StorefrontCompose product and landing pages from typed components with instant preview on every branch.
CheckoutDrive the full cart-to-payment flow through the Lantern API with retries and idempotent orders.
